g.text: 6-ft Interior Palace Tide Stair & Upper Tide-Lock
Dry Threshold Ledge & Bronze Inner Ward-Grate
The Wading Floor (60 ft · ribbed basalt & pools)
Seaward Flood-Arch (24 × 18 ft) & Outer Basalt Sill
◆ Footing & surfaces. Dry limestone Threshold Ledge sits two wet steps above the 60-ft Wading Floor (ribbed basalt
channels & ankle-deep glass-clear pools). Outside the arch lies the broad, wave-washed black Outer Basalt Sill over
◆ Sightlines (Turn 47). Sixty feet straight west from Aurelie at the top wet step to Prince filling the 24-ft Flood-Arch.
Eris stays dry one pace behind her left shoulder at the bronze rail; Varian holds the grate wheel with the ward-smith
◆ Two separate approaches. The 6-ft Interior Tide Stair admits Fae single-file only — Prince's 24-ft wings cannot enter
the shaft. He approached by the cleared Seaward Sky-Lane and holds the 24 × 18 ft seaward exit with open sky
◆ Two-hour flood-sill clock. Upper locks drained eight minutes prior at morning dead low water. When the tide turns,
seawater climbs +10 ft up the limestone stair shaft, submerging reliefs, ward-stone, bronze grate, and locks.
◆ Next beats (C → D). Any shed token goes first to the Harbor Quay Salt-Fire Anvil (C) to burn out tracking-threads,
then up to the Upper Palace Council Loggia (D) for Tarquin's ten-minute closed-door audience.
TURN 47 LIVE POSITIONS (TOKENS IN PANELS I & II)
Aurelie — top wet step · facing west
